'''Cory Allen Jefferson''' (born December 26, 1990) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career with the [[Baylor Bears basketball]] team. He is regarded as one of the better big men in the [[Big 12 Conference]] and has participated for the [[United States at the 2013 Summer Universiade|United States]] in the [[2013 Summer Universiade]] at [[Kazan, Russia]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Hill|first1=Jerry|title=WORLD TRAVELERS: International Experience Benefits Heslip, Jefferson|url=http://www.baylor.edu/bearfoundation/news.php?action=story&story=137894|website=Baylor.edu|accessdate=8 June 2014}}</ref> Jefferson is entered in the [[2014 NBA Draft]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Cory Jefferson |url=http://www.nbadraft.net/players/cory-jefferson|website=NBADraft.net|accessdate=8 June 2014}}</ref> as a fifth-year senior after his second season at Baylor was redshirted to retain eligibility in NCAA. He attended [[Killeen High School]], where he helped the team achieve an undefeated home record. In his final year at Killen, the power forward earned numerous honors such as First-Team Texas Association of Basketball Coaches (TABC) All-State and TABC Class 4A Player of the Year. Jefferson is expected to be selected in the later rounds of the NBA Draft.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cory Jefferson Bio - Baylor Bears|url=http://www.baylorbears.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/cory_jefferson_456100.html|website=BaylorBears.com|accessdate=8 June 2014}}</ref>
